question: Croft's Limited avocado oil manufacturer
markdown:
Crofts Limited
is
a prominent Kenyan manufacturer of extra virgin and crude avocado oil founded in 2013
. Located and operating out of Kenya (with processing near Thika/Nairobi), the company is led by co-founder and CEO Miraj Shah. They specialize in cold-pressed, chemical-free edible and cosmetic grade oils.
CDR Foodlab
Company Overview & Operations
Founding Year:
2013 (production began around 2015)
Location:
Kenya (Processing plant near Thika / Offices in Nairobi)
Key Leadership:
Miraj Shah (Co-founder and CEO)
Volume:
Processes roughly 70 metric tons of avocados daily, producing over 400 metric tons of oil annually
Instagram
crofts_avocadooil
Production & Sustainability
Sourcing:
Purchases fruit directly from local smallholder farmers and export packhouses, utilizing sorted ripe fruit alongside rejected or surplus crop.
Method:
Hand-sorted and single cold-pressed extraction with no added chemicals, preservatives, or artificial treatments.
Zero-Waste Model:
Repurposes waste extraction byproducts into organic fertilizer and biochar to support local agriculture.

Products & Export Markets
Extra Virgin Avocado Oil:
Premium edible grade, cold-pressed from perfectly ripe hand-sorted fruit.
Crude Avocado Oil:
Industrial and cosmetic grade produced from secondary or overripe fruit.
Global Distribution:
Exports over 98% of its production internationally to Western Europe, the UK, the USA, India, Australia, China, and Southeast Asia. Official inquiries can be made via the
